description: AccessProof production backup prerequisite inspection; pinned instance, fixed read-only commands, no secrets or arbitrary parameters.

runCommand: for bin in python3 aws pg_dump pg_restore docker systemctl; do if command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "HOST_TOOL_${bin}=PRESENT"; else echo "HOST_TOOL_${bin}=MISSING"; fi; done
docker exec "$DBID" psql -U accessproof -d accessproof -tAc 'select version()' | sed -E 's/(PostgreSQL [0-9]+).*/\1/' | sed 's/^/DB_CONTAINER_DATABASE=/'
if test -f /etc/accessproof-backup/config.env; then echo BACKUP_CONFIG_PRESENT=YES; else echo BACKUP_CONFIG_PRESENT=NO; fi
if test -e /etc/accessproof-backup/pgpass; then echo BACKUP_PGPASS_PRESENT=YES; else echo BACKUP_PGPASS_PRESENT=NO; fi
